info.title: Nylorun Runtime: Tenant API
info.description: Agents, sessions and their events, vaults, access and the Tenant's settings. A Runtime serves one Tenant: its URL is the Tenant's, and no request names it. Every request sends `Nylorun-Protocol`. Who may call each operation is its `security` and its `x-nylorun-credentials`, `x-nylorun-scopes` (the subject scopes that reach it) and `x-nylorun-browser` fields.

servers.description: A Runtime: the local stack (`nylorun start`), or where yours runs

applicationKey.description: An application key of the Tenant, or a key derived from the admin key. With `Nylorun-Subject` and `Nylorun-Scopes`, it acts for that person, narrowed to those scopes.

subjectToken.description: A subject token (`POST /v1/tokens`): one person and one role of the access policy, for at most 15 minutes.

deliveryToken.description: The delivery token the Runtime signs each Action delivery with (`Nylorun-Signature`), sent back by the Action endpoint. It reaches only that Action's heartbeat, result and sandbox routes, while that delivery is current, for at most 15 minutes.

publishableKey.name: Nylorun-Key
publishableKey.description: A publishable key, sent by a browser page on one of its origins. Public by design: it grants the access policy's anonymous scopes.

A2aAgentCard.description: The agent's A2A card, without interfaces

method.description: `SendMessage`, `GetTask` or `CancelTask`; others answer their A2A error

get.description: The protocol range and features a client checks first. Refuses an `Origin`.
The listeners, the Tenant (open), Postgres, Restate and S2.

503.description: Not ready: `checks` says what is not

get.description: Server-sent events, each with its type as `event` and its cursor as `id`, from the cursor on. Events are on the `nylorun.event/2` envelope, typed by `SessionEvent`; a client ignores a type it does not know. A subject token's stream ends with `event: nylorun.closed` when the token expires or the subject is revoked. A `: keepalive` comment every 15 seconds.
